doctor: NAME_1, how long already the cough?
patient: Three days doctor, malam lagi teruk. Ada kahak kuning.
doctor: Any chest pain or breathless?
patient: No chest pain. Sikit-sikit breathless when climb stairs only.
doctor: Temperature 37.9, pulse 92, oxygen 97 percent. Throat red, chest clear. This is viral upper respiratory infection. Paracetamol 1 gram four times a day if fever. Review in one week, come earlier if breathless worsen or fever not settle. I order FBC if not improving.
output:
Title: Viral Upper Respiratory Infection Symptoms
## Subjective
- Cough three days, worse at night
- Yellow sputum present
- Slight breathlessness on climbing stairs
## Objective
- Temperature 37.9°C
- Pulse 92 bpm
- Oxygen saturation 97%
- Red throat; Chest clear upon auscultation
## Assessment
- Likely viral upper respiratory infection
## Plan
- Paracetamol 1g every six hours PRN fever
## Orders & Follow-ups
- Review in seven days
- Present sooner with worsening dyspnea
- Order Full Blood Count if non-improving

input:
doctor: NAME_1 what brings you in?
patient: Itchy rash on both arms since yesterday, doctor. Very itchy at night.
doctor: Any new soaps, foods, medicines?
patient: I used a new detergent two days ago.
doctor: Rash looks like contact dermatitis. Stop the detergent. Cetirizine 10 milligram at night for five days. Come back if it spreads or blisters.
output:
Title: Contact Dermatitis – Arm Rashes
## Subjective
- Itchy rash developed overnight on both arms.
- Intense itching primarily during nighttime hours.
- New detergent use noted recently.
## Objective
- Rash appearance suggests contact dermatitis.
## Assessment
- Likely contact dermatitis triggered by detergent exposure.
## Plan
- Discontinue using the newly introduced detergent immediately.
## Orders & Follow-ups
- Initiate cetirizine 10mg nightly for five days.
- Reassess return visit if spread occurs or blistering develops.

Title: Diabetes management and knee care

- Morning sugars approximately seven mmol/L
- Knee pain worsening for two weeks
- Ibuprofen used occasionally for pain relief

- Fasting glucose 6.8mmol/L
- Blood Pressure 128/82 mmHg
- Weight remains stable

- Increasing knee joint discomfort

- Topical Diclofenac Gel thrice daily for knees
- HbA1c testing completed
- Physio referral initiated

## Orders & Follow-ups
- Three month review following HbA1c result
- Continue Metformin 500mg BID
- Safety net – return sooner if needed
